args.article: Today's AI agents landscape is shifting rapidly from experimentation to production. Open-source agent frameworks have tripled adoption as model-driven agents replace hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability is emerging as the key benchmark for frontier models, while multi-agent swarms advance into regulated enterprise workflows. Meanwhile, new observability standards are being established to trace agent decisions end to end.
